You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository Textualize/rich.

Problem Statement:
Fix raw markup printed on prompt errors sometimes

## Type of changes

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation / docstrings
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [x] I've run the latest [black](https://github.com/psf/black) with default args on new code.
- [ ] I've updated CHANGELOG.md and CONTRIBUTORS.md where appropriate (see note about typos above).
- [x] I've added tests for new code.
- [x] I accept that @willmcgugan may be pedantic in the code review.

## Description

PromptBase.on_validate_error() should explicitly ask for markup in case the console passed to it has markup disabled globally.

Fixes #3881.

## Task Budget (Session terminates when any budget is exhausted)
- Time allowance: 5.0 minutes
- Tool calls allowance: 70 calls
- Max loop iterations: 150 turns

- Single command timeout: 180 seconds (commands exceeding this fail without ending the session)

- File view limit: 150 lines per read_file call

steps.message:
FILES: rich/prompt.py:258-262
ROOT CAUSE: In `PromptBase.on_validate_error`, `self.console.print(error)` is called. If the console has markup disabled globally, the markup in the `error` message will be printed as raw text.
CHANGE: Change `self.console.print(error)` to `self.console.print(error, markup=True)`.
TEST: tests/test_prompt.py
